b: The word “talent” is misused quite often, especially with kids or anyone young who is pursuing a creative endeavor. It can obscure proper learning and study habits, and later it can contribute to anxiety, and even depression, when things don’t go the way the would-be creative expected. It can also breed resentment and hostility toward a world that seems to have cheated this “talented” person. This video covers ten myths that surround the word talent and explains why it shouldn’t be used to label someone, especially when they are young and untrained.
